overview_description.description:
Ancana is a marketplace where people can buy, sell and enjoy a fully managed vacation home through co-ownership. We partner with top developers around the world to implement a co-ownership product into their developments, offering a 5 star hospitality service to owners.
Ancana takes care of everything that makes purchasing and owning a vacation home complicated while enjoying the great benefits owning a piece of it. Ancana uses technology to to manage and make scheduling your nights seamless and simple.

about_short_description.short_description: Marketplace where people can buy a fully managed vacation home through co-ownership.

product.name: Fractional Ownership Vacation Homes
product.description: Allows customers to buy a share of a vacation home, granting legal ownership and usage rights for a portion of the year.

product.name: Property Management and Maintenance Services
product.description: Manages cleaning, maintenance, and upkeep of the vacation homes to ensure a hassle-free ownership experience for co-owners.

identifier.value: Owners’ Portal for Scheduling and Management

product.name: Owners’ Portal for Scheduling and Management
product.description: A digital platform that allows co-owners to select usage weeks, manage bookings, and coordinate property use efficiently.

product.name: Concierge Services
product.description: Provides personalized assistance to owners for booking services and ensuring a smooth and enjoyable stay at their vacation home.

product.name: Rental Management Program
product.description: Manages the rental of owners’ unused weeks, handling guest bookings and maximizing rental income on behalf of owners.

product.name: Global Home Exchange Program
product.description: Enables owners to exchange their usage weeks for stays at over 15,000 luxury properties worldwide through a partnership with ThirdHome.
